# Singularity design system

> Components, tokens and rules for Singularity apps (`@singularityfm/design-system`). Pick a part here before writing a class or a value; a part that fits is used as it is, none fits means ask the owner. Never invent a control class.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/system/build.ts (npm run system). Do not edit. -->
Ask `ds find "<need>"`, `ds part <id>` or `ds token <words>`, not this whole file (`pnpm exec ds` in an app, `pnpm run ds` here). Rules for an app: AGENTS.md. All pages in one file: llms-full.txt. Data: system.json.

## Parts
An id links to its page (import, markup, props). What it is. Use: when. Not: situation → part instead.
- [button-filled](parts/button-filled.md): The accent fill under its own words; the most prominent button. Use: It is the one action that commits a sheet, a dialog or an empty page: Save, Add category, Listen now. Not: Another filled button is on the same surface: make the second one Tonal → button-tonal.
- [button-tonal](parts/button-tonal.md): The accent container under its own words, with no outline; quieter than Filled. Use: It is the alternative beside a Filled button. Not: It is the only action that commits the surface → button-filled.
- [button-text](parts/button-text.md): An accent label with no container until it is hovered or pressed; the quietest button. Use: It dismisses, backs out or repeats: Cancel, Clear, Try again, Hide this. Not: The action must be found at a glance on its own → button-filled.
- [button-danger](parts/button-danger.md): A Text button in the danger colour. Use: It is the confirm of a delete, in a dialog that asks first: Delete, Delete source. Not: The action is not destructive, or nobody has been asked to confirm → button-text.
- [button-small](parts/button-small.md): A shorter pill, same touch target. Use: It sits in a dense row or a popover. Not: It commits a sheet → button-filled.
- [icon-btn](parts/icon-btn.md): A glyph in a round 44px target, quiet until used. Use: One glyph says what it does: Close, Back, More, Share. Not: It is the companion of a primary action: Share beside Play → icon-btn-tonal. Experimental: variant="filled".
- [icon-btn-tonal](parts/icon-btn-tonal.md): A circle on the container fill, beside a primary action. Use: The companion of a primary action in one row: Share beside Play. Not: A lone toolbar glyph, or one in every row → icon-btn.
- [fab](parts/fab.md): The page's one primary action below 64rem: a glyph and a word, floating. Use: One creating action a phone needs in reach: Catch up, Add a source. Not: The action sits in a form or a sheet → button-filled.
- [text-link](parts/text-link.md): A link inside a line of small text; the words stay inline, the target is 44px. Use: A link inside a hint, a sentence or a breadcrumb. Not: It stands alone as an action → button-text.
- [source-link](parts/source-link.md): The one link out of a story: the publisher's name, underlined on hover. Use: Name the publisher a story or a highlight came from. Not: It sits inside a sentence → text-link.
- [play-chip](parts/play-chip.md): The tonal pill that plays a briefing or one story, with its state. Use: Play an episode or a story and show idle, current, played, error or preparing. Not: A person ticks a choice → filter-chip. Experimental: primary.
- [filter-chip](parts/filter-chip.md): A checkbox drawn as a pill; ticked it takes the accent container. Use: Tick several topics or categories to include. Not: Exactly one of a few values → segmented-choice.
- [segmented-choice](parts/segmented-choice.md): One pill of radio items: pick exactly one value. Use: Choose one of two to four short values: Length, Format, Tone. Not: Switching between views → segmented-nav.
- [segmented-nav](parts/segmented-nav.md): A tonal track with one sliding pill: switch between views of the same content. Use: Switch the view of one page or panel without leaving it: a topic's Sources and Preferences. Not: Choosing the value of a setting → segmented-choice.
- [search-field](parts/search-field.md): The rounded search pill, on the container tone, with its glyph. Use: Search or filter a list by text: the Library, Sources, Downloads. Not: A text field in a form → field. Experimental: clearable.
- [icon](parts/icon.md): A filled Phosphor glyph in the colour of the text beside it. Use: A mark beside a label or alone in a button: a chevron, a plus, a check, Play. Not: The glyph must act when pressed → icon-btn. Experimental: --icon-size.
- [badge](parts/badge.md): A grey label holding one word or one number beside a name. Use: A short label names what the thing beside it is: Admin beside the wordmark. Not: The state is good, worth a look or wrong → banner.
- [switch](parts/switch.md): A track and a thumb for one setting that is on or off. Use: A setting is on or off and applies as soon as it is flipped: Sounds, Autoplay, a podcast's Enabled. Not: The choice is one of several values, or needs a Save to apply → filter-chip.
- [slider](parts/slider.md): A track with a thumb: a value between two ends, set by dragging or by the arrow keys. Use: The value is on a scale where nearby values are alike: Volume, Playback speed, a topic's weight. Not: There are two to five named options and none is between the others → filter-chip.
- [field](parts/field.md): An outlined box for text a person types: one line, or several lines (multiline). Use: A person types a short value or a few lines: a title, a feed address, a prompt. Not: The value is one of two to four short options → segmented-choice. Experimental: tonal.
- [select](parts/select.md): A native select with its own chevron. Use: A person picks one value from a list of five or more, or of names that are too long for a row of chips. Not: the value is one of two to four short options → segmented-choice.
- [menu](parts/menu.md): A short list of actions that opens from an icon button: a row each, its glyph first. Use: A card, header or row has more actions than room: Download, Add to queue, Share, Delete. Not: The person picks one value from a list → select. Experimental: flush.
- [banner](parts/banner.md): A tinted block with an icon, a title, an optional line and at most one text button. Use: A state a person must know about stays on screen: offline, a failed run, a playback error. Not: A banner in the page would be moved around by a page change (a cover between pages) → banner.
- [toast](parts/toast.md): One quiet message at a time on the inverse surface, with an optional action. Use: A brief message with Undo after a delete. Not: A notice that must stay → banner.
- [dialog](parts/dialog.md): A small centred box with a heading and a row of buttons: one question, one tap. Use: A person confirms what cannot be undone: Delete, Discard, Switch profile. Not: The question needs fields to answer → sheet.
- [sheet](parts/sheet.md): A panel over the page for a form or a list: full screen on a phone, at the right from 40rem. Use: Something to fill in or edit that needs room: New episode, a topic, a source. Not: One question and its answers → dialog.
- [drawer](parts/drawer.md): The island modal for a form: the whole screen on a phone, a panel at the right from 40rem, with Close in the header. Use: A React island opens a form over the page, as Regenerate does. Not: The sheet is drawn by Astro or a script → sheet.
- [ripple](parts/ripple.md): A wave from the touch point that fills a control's touch area, then fades. Use: A large touch target on a phone must show where it was pressed: a bottom bar tab. Not: A small control needs a press state → icon-btn.
- [btn-action-tonal](parts/btn-action-tonal.md): The one creating action in the side column (Catch up), on the action tone. Use: the Catch up action in the side column. Not: any other button → button-tonal.
- [tabs](parts/tabs.md): A sticky strip of links to the sections of one page. Use: jump to the sections of a briefing or an episode. Not: switching between two views → segmented-nav.
- [row-action](parts/row-action.md): A row that is one link or button: the whole row responds as a rounded tile. Use: a settings row that opens a sub-page. Not: a row that holds a switch or a select → settings-row.
- [card-group](parts/card-group.md): A group of rows in one rounded container on the container tone. Use: group several settings rows. Not: a single stat or number → stat-tiles.
- [settings-row](parts/settings-row.md): A row with a label and an in-place control: a switch, a select or a value. Use: a setting with a switch. Not: a row that opens another page → row-action.
- [empty-state](parts/empty-state.md): A spot illustration, a title, one line and at most two actions, for a page with nothing in it. Use: a page or section with nothing to list yet. Not: a list that has items → card-group.
- [multiselect](parts/multiselect.md): A field-like trigger that opens a list of checkable choices. Use: choose several from a long list. Not: a few choices that fit on screen → filter-chip.
- [stat-tiles](parts/stat-tiles.md): A tile per figure: the value large over its word in muted ink. Use: figures on a dashboard. Not: a list of rows → card-group.
- [section-head](parts/section-head.md): A section header with more room above than below, so it belongs to what follows. Use: title a group of rows or cards on a page.
- [meta](parts/meta.md): One quiet line of facts, separated by centered dots. Use: date, duration and source under a title.
- [cover](parts/cover.md): A generated cover image, drawn once per theme. Use: show an episode or briefing cover.

## Color roles
Components read only these (never a hex, never a primitive color).
- --color-surface: Page background.
- --color-surface-sunken: Wells, inputs, hover fills, track backgrounds.
- --color-surface-container: The tonal fill of a control that sits on the page
- --color-surface-raised: Sheets and dialogs.
- --color-surface-overlay: Floating chrome
- --color-surface-inverse: Toasts.
- --color-on-surface: The headline ink on the page and on every surface.
- --color-on-surface-reading: Running text read under a heading in on-surface
- --color-on-surface-muted: Secondary text.
- --color-on-surface-disabled: Disabled controls only.
- --color-on-surface-inverse: Text and glyphs on the inverse surface, which toasts use.
- --color-border-hairline: Decorative dividers.
- --color-border-control: Boundary of an input or segmented control.
- --color-track: Rail and scrubber track.
- --color-track-strong: Unplayed item ticks and upcoming nodes.
- --color-accent: Lingonberry.
- --color-on-accent-container: Text and icons on accent-container.
- --color-accent-container-high: The tone of an action that is not a place
- --color-on-accent-container-high: Text and icons on accent-container-high.
- --color-accent-action: The tone of the one creating action in the side column (Catch up).
- --color-on-accent-action: Text and icons on accent-action, at 4.5:1 in rest, hover and press.
- --color-on-accent: Words and glyphs on the accent fill, and a switch's thumb.
- --color-cover-accent: Defaults to the accent.
- --color-on-cover-accent: Words on a cover's accent.
- --color-focus-ring: The keyboard focus ring, in the accent.
- --color-focus-gap: Inner ring color.
- --color-scrim: Dims the page behind a sheet, dialog, drawer or picker.
- --color-on-scrim: Words on the scrim over a cover.
- --color-accent-on-inverse: The accent on the inverse surface (a toast), the other theme's step
- --color-image-outline: 1px outline on covers for perceived edge, per DESIGN.md.
- --color-success: The good state
- --color-warning: A state worth a look
- --color-danger: A failure or a destructive action.
- --color-favorite: The filled heart.
- --color-favorite-glow: The heart's halo.
- --color-info: A neutral notice tone.
- <tone>-subtle for accent, success, warning, danger, info: the tone's tinted background
- --color-<fill>-hover and -pressed for accent, accent-container, accent-container-high, accent-action, surface, surface-sunken, surface-container, surface-container-focus, surface-raised, surface-overlay, surface-inverse, surface-inverse-action, accent-subtle: its state fills

## Scales
Read directly by components.
- --space-{1 0.25rem, 2 0.5rem, 4 1rem, 6 1.5rem, 8 2rem, 12 3rem, 16 4rem, 24 6rem}
- --radius-{round 9999px}
- --shape-{xs, sm, md, lg, xl, sheet, 2xl}: corners, a style redraws them
- --stroke-{hairline 1px, rail 2px, ring 2px, ring-gap 2px}
- --duration-{press-in 100ms, press-out 160ms, hover 150ms, state 200ms, enter 250ms, exit 150ms, sheet-in 300ms, sheet-out 220ms, drawer-full 500ms, progress 250ms, stagger 40ms, theme 200ms, spin 800ms, spring-settle 650ms, spring-release 750ms, spring-pop 450ms, spring-spatial-fast 350ms, spring-spatial-default 420ms, spring-spatial-slow 570ms, spring-effects-fast 140ms, spring-effects-default 220ms, spring-effects-slow 310ms}
- --ease-{out, in-out, drawer, hover, linear linear, spring-settle, spring-release, spring-pop, spring-spatial-fast, spring-spatial-default, spring-spatial-slow, spring-effects-fast, spring-effects-default, spring-effects-slow}

## Component tokens
Sizes per part: cover, rail, item, cta, action, button, mini, player, control, scrubber, hue, segmented, field, switch, checkbox, sheet, toast, banner, archive, chip, app, queue, nav, tabs, row, slider, picker, scene, card. List one with `ds token <group>`.
